description.value: Casey's Community House is a community-oriented restaurant and bar in downtown Creston, BC, positioning itself around community connection and good food. The venue features billiards and a selection of various beers. Access from the rear parking lot is level, making it approachable for cyclists arriving loaded.

raw_osm.description: Level entry from rear parking lot, stairs in front.
raw_osm.name: Casey's Community House
